notes:
• 861 exercises with start/finish photos, Arabic gym names and search in both languages. New exercise page with a mini muscle map and how-to tips.
• Smarter swap: every option says Easier, Same level or Harder, and the list stays tied to the exercise in your plan.
• Effort is simpler: Easy, Hard or Failure after each set, plus a separate "it hurt" button. The app adds weight when sets feel easy.
• Live workout: number keypad, plate math, quick peek at last sessions, spoken cues and a short recap when you finish.
• Planner: rotating days, supersets, automatic warm-up sets, progression modes, and share or import plans.
• Progress: body measurements, weekly sets per muscle on the body map, and CSV import from Strong, Hevy and FitNotes.
• Daily Google Drive backup turns on when you sign in. Your profile photo on Home opens Profile and Settings.
• Friends: a clearer Forge Score with a breakdown of bonuses for PRs, protein days and extra workouts.
• Removed: Fitbit readiness. Health Connect is now used only for steps, calories burned and weight.
